common.source_compatibility_patch: Only duration validation permits 362 VAE-aligned frames; applied equally to all arms.

dit_mxfp8: DiT transformer block Q, K, V, O, FF input and FF output GEMMs: MXFP8 A8W8 only; retain original BF16 FSDP parameters and communication
sage_attention: VSA fine sparse attention: Sage QK INT8 / PV FP8 only; original pooling, masks, coarse branch, gate and collectives
vae_mxfp8: Video VAE decoder block Q, K, V, O, FF input and FF output GEMMs: MXFP8 A8W8 only
vae_nvfp4: Same video VAE decoder GEMMs: NVFP4 A4W4 only
dit_mxfp8_o_bf16: Relative to the page DiT MXFP8 arm: retain original BF16 attention to_out in all 50 blocks; Q/K/V and FF input/output retain the identical MXFP8 implementation.
dit_mxfp8_qkvo_bf16: Relative to DiT MXFP8 + BF16 O: also restore Q/K/V to original BF16. All 200 attention Q/K/V/O projections use original BF16; 100 FFN input/output projections retain the identical MXFP8 implementation.
dit_mxfp8_first_step_original: First DiT denoising forward: all original BF16 projections. Last three forwards: all 300 DiT Q/K/V/O and FFN projections MXFP8, identical to the existing DiT MXFP8 control. VSA kernel remains original throughout.
sage_first_step_original: First DiT denoising forward: original Triton VSA attention. Last three forwards: identical Sage Attention kernel to the existing Sage control. All DiT projections remain original BF16 throughout.

normalization: Only add missing leading i in integrated_multimodal_description for prompts 03, 05, 07; remove user group labels; no padding, truncation or prompt rewriting.
extension_only_change: For each method separately, use original operations on the first of four denoising forwards; use the existing lossy method on the final three. No sampling schedule, VAE, sparsity, projection scope, or checkpoint changes.

extension_schedule.granularity_note: Four actual DiT forwards. First full denoising step is 25% by forward count, not 10%; sampling schedule unchanged.
